import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Define color palette for species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter plots for key relationships
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Top left: Sepal Length vs Width
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sepal Dimensions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# Top middle: Petal Length vs Width
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Petal Dimensions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# Top right: Sepal vs Petal Length
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax3.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['petal_length'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Sepal vs Petal Length', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(fontsize=8)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# Middle row: Box plots for each measurement
measurements = ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']
labels = ['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth']

ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
positions = []
for i, species in enumerate(['setosa', 'versicolor', 'virginica']):
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    data_to_plot = [subset[meas].values for meas in measurements]
    pos = [j*4 + i for j in range(len(measurements))]
    positions.extend(pos)
    bp = ax4.boxplot(data_to_plot, positions=pos, widths=0.6, 
                     patch_artist=True, 
                     boxprops=dict(facecolor=colors[species], alpha=0.7),
                     medianprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=2),
                     whiskerprops=dict(color='black'),
                     capprops=dict(color='black'))

ax4.set_xticks([0.5, 4.5, 8.5, 12.5])
ax4.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Create custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=colors[sp], alpha=0.7, label=sp.capitalize()) 
                  for sp in ['setosa', 'versicolor', 'virginica']]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right', fontsize=9)

# Bottom left: Violin plot for petal length
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
parts = ax5.violinplot([df[df['species'] == sp]['petal_length'].values 
                        for sp in ['setosa', 'versicolor', 'virginica']], 
                       positions=[1, 2, 3], widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(list(colors.values())[i])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
ax5.set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
ax5.set_xticklabels(['Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'], fontsize=9)
ax5.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Petal Length Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Bottom middle: Correlation heatmap
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
corr_matrix = df[measurements].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            square=True, ax=ax6, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8},
            xticklabels=['SL', 'SW', 'PL', 'PW'],
            yticklabels=['Sepal L', 'Sepal W', 'Petal L', 'Petal W'])
ax6.set_title('Feature Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Bottom right: Mean measurements comparison
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
species_means = df.groupby('species')[measurements].mean()
x = np.arange(len(measurements))
width = 0.25
for i, species in enumerate(['setosa', 'versicolor', 'virginica']):
    ax7.bar(x + i*width, species_means.loc[species], width, 
           label=species.capitalize(), color=colors[species], alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax7.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
